title: Heated Rooftop Pools, Games, 2Homes,Sleeps23
description:
Nashvilleurbanretreats presents a True Unicorn! 2 Luxury Homes, Rooftop Pools with a total of 4000 sq ft for a unique Nashville experience. Enjoy the rooftop heated rooftop pools with unparalleled city views. Rooftops have a half bath and beverage fridge so you can keep the fun going.  Elevator for easy access. 3 King beds and 7 Queen beds (including 3 trundles) throughout the properties, sleeps 23. Conveniently located in East Nashville for quick access from the airport and into downtown.

The space
★PRICE INCLUDES BOTH UNITS★
★POOLS ARE PRIVATE AND FOR USE ONLY BY YOUR PARTY★

Enjoy the rooftop plunge pools, with a *new* upgraded heater to get to 100 degrees year around!  Who needs a tiny hot tub!

We are local owners, not a huge property management company.  We care about your experience and the quality of the experience of your stay.
TWO brand new construction Nashville Townhomes! These gorgeous homes are brand new construction and newly furnished by a local designer and are professionally decorated with every detail in mind!
2 adjoining houses in Music City JAW DROPPING rooftops with amazing DOWNTOWN Nashville City Views! 2 Side by Side Houses 2 Stunning Rooftop Decks with PLUNGE POOLS!  2 Chef's Kitchens 8 Bedrooms 6 Full Bathrooms and 4 Half Baths, 2 Dining Rooms 2 Living Rooms 2 Single garages Multiple Selfie Walls. Great for large groups, bachelorette/bachelor trips, families & anyone looking for a unique stay. These two townhomes are connected, but standalone from other units in our complex so you have a building completely to you and your guests. Located in East Nashville, you and your group will love the entertainment spaces provided within the homes as well as the endless local spots just a short drive away.

Unit 1: Let's Flamingle!
Immerse yourself in this fun, tropical inspired retreat.  This 4-bedroom, 3 Full and 2 half bathroom home has an unmatched rooftop experience. Modern furniture, hardwood floors with herringbone accents, vibrant art and decor. As an added amenity, the elevators will make it easy to carry your luggage up and down.
Rooftop:  Private Heated Plunge Pool, can be heated to 100 degrees in colder months for year round use.  Excellent sun exposure and great outdoor seating and lounge chairs for your stay.  Rooftop has a half bath and a beverage fridge that can be pre stocked upon request (fee applies)
Pool is serviced on Thursdays mornings. Technicians will take the elevator on the garage level all the way to the rooftop and will not be in the house.
Level 3:  3 Bedrooms on this level.  Bedroom 1 has 2 side by side King beds.   Bedroom 2 has a queen sized bed.  Bedroom 3 has a Queen Sized Bed with a Trundle  pull out below with a glamorous makeup counter for the crew to get ready. There are 2 full baths on level 3

Unit 2: Swanky Jungle Oasis
Immerse yourself in this fun, electric jungle inspired retreat.  This 4-bedroom, 3 Full and 2 half bathroom home has an unmatched rooftop experience. The spacious, light-filled living area and modern kitchen are ideal for groups or families. Located in East Nashville, you're minutes from downtown's music scene and local hotspots. Working from the rooftop down on the elevator.
Rooftop:  Private Heated Plunge Pool, can be heated to 95 degrees in colder months for year round use.  Excellent sun exposure and outdoor seating/ lounge chairs for your stay.  Rooftop has a half bath and a beverage fridge that can be pre stocked upon request (fee applies)
Pool is serviced on Thursdays mornings. Technicians will take the elevator on the garage level all the way to the rooftop and will not be in the house.
Level 3:  3 Bedrooms on this level.  Bedroom 1 is a suite and it has 2 side by side Queen beds with an attached bathroom.   Bedroom 2 has a King bed.  Bedroom 3 has a Queen Bed. Bedrooms 2 and 3 share a full bathroom.

Guest access
You will have access to the entire home. We will send you the access code via email with the entry instructions. The host is available if you have any questions or inquiries. 

_
KITCHEN & DINING
The home features a gorgeous kitchen and two wide-open living rooms. For those who love to cook, this is a fully equipped kitchen.

_
BATHROOMS
You'll also find hairdryers in each bathroom along with plenty of spa-quality shampoos, conditioners, and body wash.
_
BEDROOMS
Enjoy the cool comfort and support of our hybrid mattresses and super soft  linens. Blackout curtains and white noise machines for a peaceful night. 
_
BOARD GAMES
You'll find board and card games scattered throughout the home if you decide to stay in and enjoy the house.
Rooftop also offers some lawn game options.

Waivers for the pool and elevator will be sent and need to be signed within 24 hours of the reservation request.

Security Cameras Cover All External Areas, including the pools for Insurance Liability Purposes

Because of the proximity to main roads and proximity to the city center, you will hear "city noise"
All bedrooms are equipped with sound machines.
